explanation: Bodies 0 (m~17.2) and 2 (m~3.27) undergo a fast close encounter: distance 1.439 at step 4 shrinking to 1.079 at step 5, speeds ~9.2-9.5. The integrator hits max substeps_in_step=16 at steps 3-5 but still cannot resolve strong softened gravity (G~4.07), so leapfrog pairwise force asymmetry/time-step error accumulates as net momentum drift (0.385 vs 0.194 allowed) at step 5. Reducing dt alone eliminates failure, confirming timestep-resolution cause.
vision_note: Two bodies in the upper left stay in a tight pair while a third body remains isolated far to the right. No explosion or sudden jump is visible through step 5, only short motion trails as the close pair persists.
